en: Every stump that started up in their path seemed a man and an enemy, and made them catch their breath; and as they sped by some outlying cottages that lay near the village, the barking of the aroused watch-dogs seemed to give wings to their feet.
ko: 길에 불쑥 나타나는 그루터기 하나하나가 사람처럼, 적처럼 보여 아이들의 숨을 멎게 했다. 그리고 마을 근처의 외딴 오두막들 옆을 내달릴 때, 잠에서 깬 개들이 짖는 소리는 아이들의 발에 날개를 달아 주는 듯했다.

chunks.en: Every stump that started up in their path
seemed a man and an enemy,
and made them catch their breath;
and as they sped by some outlying cottages
chunks.ko: 그리고 외딴 오두막들 옆을 급히 지날 때

chunks.en: that lay near the village,
the barking of the aroused watch-dogs
chunks.ko: 잠에서 깬 집 지키는 개들의 짖는 소리가

chunks.en: seemed to give wings to their feet.

en: Huckleberry’s hard pantings were his only reply, and the boys fixed their eyes on the goal of their hopes and bent to their work to win it.
ko: 허클베리는 거칠게 헐떡이는 것으로 대답을 대신했고, 아이들은 바라던 목표에 눈을 고정한 채 그곳에 닿으려고 온 힘을 다해 달렸다.

chunks.en: Huckleberry’s hard pantings
were his only reply,
and the boys fixed their eyes
on the goal of their hopes
and bent to their work to win it.
chunks.ko: 그리고 그것을 얻으려 (달리기에) 온 힘을 쏟았다.

en: They gained steadily on it, and at last, breast to breast, they burst through the open door and fell grateful and exhausted in the sheltering shadows beyond.
ko: 아이들은 그곳에 점점 가까워졌고, 마침내 나란히 열린 문으로 뛰어들어, 문 안쪽의 몸을 숨겨 주는 그늘 속에 고마운 마음으로 기진맥진 쓰러졌다.

chunks.en: They gained steadily on it,
and at last, breast to breast,
they burst through the open door
and fell grateful and exhausted
in the sheltering shadows beyond.
chunks.ko: 그 너머 몸을 숨겨 주는 그늘 속에.

en: That Injun devil wouldn’t make any more of drownding us than a couple of cats, if we was to squeak ’bout this and they didn’t hang him.
ko: 우리가 이 일을 찍소리라도 하고, 그런데도 사람들이 그놈을 목매달지 않으면, 그 인전 놈은 우리를 물에 빠뜨려 죽이는 걸 고양이 두 마리 빠뜨리는 것보다 조금도 더 대수롭게 여기지 않을 거야.

chunks.en: That Injun devil wouldn’t make any more
chunks.ko: 그 인전 놈은 조금도 더 대수롭게 여기지 않을 거야

chunks.en: of drownding us than a couple of cats,
chunks.ko: 우리를 물에 빠뜨리는 걸, 고양이 두 마리(빠뜨리는 것)보다,
chunks.r: 비교(not any more … than: ~보다 조금도 더 …않다)

chunks.en: if we was to squeak ’bout this
chunks.ko: 만약 우리가 이 일을 찍소리라도 하고

chunks.en: and they didn’t hang him.

en: That’s good enough for little rubbishy common things—specially with gals, cuz they go back on you anyway, and blab if they get in a huff—but there orter be writing ’bout a big thing like this.
ko: 그건 하찮고 흔한 일에나 충분하지—특히 여자애들이랑 할 때. 걔들은 어차피 약속을 어기고, 화나면 떠벌리니까—하지만 이렇게 큰일에는 글로 써 둬야 해.

chunks.en: That’s good enough
for little rubbishy common things—specially with gals,
chunks.ko: 하찮고 흔한 일에는—특히 여자애들이랑 할 때,

chunks.en: cuz they go back on you anyway,
and blab if they get in a huff—but
there orter be writing ’bout a big thing like this.
chunks.r: 대등절(there ought to be: ~가 있어야 한다)

en: He picked up a clean pine shingle that lay in the moon-light, took a little fragment of “red keel” out of his pocket, got the moon on his work, and painfully scrawled these lines, emphasizing each slow down-stroke by clamping his tongue between his teeth, and letting up the pressure on the up-strokes.
ko: 그는 달빛 속에 놓인 깨끗한 소나무 널빤지를 집어 들고, 주머니에서 '붉은 석필' 조각을 꺼내, 달빛이 비치게 자리를 잡은 뒤 힘겹게 다음 글귀를 휘갈겼다. 느리게 내리긋는 획마다 혀를 이 사이에 꽉 물어 힘을 주고, 올려긋는 획에서는 힘을 뺐다.

chunks.en: He picked up a clean pine shingle
chunks.ko: 그는 깨끗한 소나무 널빤지를 집어 들었다

chunks.en: that lay in the moon-light,
took a little fragment of “red keel”
out of his pocket,
got the moon on his work,
and painfully scrawled these lines,
emphasizing each slow down-stroke
by clamping his tongue between his teeth,
and letting up the pressure on the up-strokes.

en: “Huck Finn and Tom Sawyer swears they will keep mum about This and They wish They may Drop down dead in Their Tracks if They ever Tell and Rot.”
ko: 허크 핀과 톰 소여는 이 일에 대해 입을 다물 것을 맹세하며, 만약 말한다면 그 자리에서 쓰러져 죽고 썩어 버리기를 바란다.

chunks.en: “Huck Finn and Tom Sawyer swears
they will keep mum about This
and They wish
They may Drop down dead in Their Tracks
if They ever Tell and Rot.”

en: In time, after many squeezes, Tom managed to sign his initials, using the ball of his little finger for a pen.
ko: 이윽고 여러 번 피를 짜낸 끝에, 톰은 새끼손가락 끝을 펜 삼아 가까스로 자기 이름 머리글자를 적었다.

chunks.en: In time, after many squeezes,
Tom managed to sign his initials,
chunks.ko: 톰은 가까스로 자기 이름 머리글자를 서명했다,

chunks.en: using the ball of his little finger for a pen.
chunks.ko: 새끼손가락 끝 볼록한 부분을 펜 삼아서.

en: They buried the shingle close to the wall, with some dismal ceremonies and incantations, and the fetters that bound their tongues were considered to be locked and the key thrown away.
ko: 그들은 음침한 의식과 주문을 곁들여 널빤지를 벽 가까이에 묻었고, 이로써 그들의 혀를 묶은 족쇄는 잠기고 열쇠는 내던져진 것으로 여겨졌다.

chunks.en: They buried the shingle close to the wall,
with some dismal ceremonies and incantations,
and the fetters that bound their tongues
were considered to be locked
and the key thrown away.

en: [* If Mr. Harbison owned a slave named Bull, Tom would have spoken of him as “Harbison’s Bull,” but a son or a dog of that name was “Bull Harbison.”]
ko: [* 하비슨 씨에게 불이라는 이름의 노예가 있었다면 톰은 그를 '하비슨의 불'이라고 불렀겠지만, 그 이름의 아들이나 개라면 '불 하비슨'이었다.]

chunks.en: [* If Mr. Harbison owned a slave named Bull,
chunks.ko: [* 만약 하비슨 씨에게 불(Bull)이라는 노예가 있었다면,

chunks.en: Tom would have spoken of him as “Harbison’s Bull,”
but a son or a dog of that name
was “Bull Harbison.”]

en: But presently the temptation rose up strong again and the boys agreed to try, with the understanding that they would take to their heels if the snoring stopped.
ko: 하지만 이윽고 유혹이 다시 강하게 일어났고, 아이들은 코 고는 소리가 멈추면 곧장 도망친다는 조건으로 한번 가 보기로 했다.

chunks.en: But presently the temptation rose up strong again
chunks.ko: 하지만 이윽고 유혹이 다시 강하게 일어났고

chunks.en: and the boys agreed to try,
with the understanding that they would take to their heels
if the snoring stopped.

en: When they had got to within five steps of the snorer, Tom stepped on a stick, and it broke with a sharp snap.
ko: 코 고는 사람에게서 다섯 걸음 안쪽까지 다가갔을 때, 톰이 나뭇가지를 밟았고, 그것이 날카롭게 딱 소리를 내며 부러졌다.

chunks.en: When they had got to within five steps of the snorer,
chunks.ko: 코 고는 사람에게서 다섯 걸음 안까지 다가갔을 때,

chunks.en: Tom stepped on a stick,
and it broke with a sharp snap.

en: They turned and saw the strange dog standing within a few feet of where Potter was lying, and facing Potter, with his nose pointing heavenward.
ko: 아이들이 돌아보니 그 낯선 개가 포터가 누워 있는 곳에서 몇 피트 떨어진 곳에 서서, 코를 하늘로 치켜든 채 포터를 마주 보고 있었다.

chunks.en: They turned and saw the strange dog
chunks.ko: 그들은 돌아서서 그 낯선 개를 보았다

chunks.en: standing within a few feet
chunks.ko: 몇 피트 안쪽에 서 있는 것을

chunks.en: of where Potter was lying,
and facing Potter,
with his nose pointing heavenward.

en: “Say, Tom—they say a stray dog come howling around Johnny Miller’s house, ’bout midnight, as much as two weeks ago; and a whippoorwill come in and lit on the banisters and sung, the very same evening; and there ain’t anybody dead there yet.”
ko: 저기, 톰—사람들 말로는 두 주나 전에 자정쯤 떠돌이 개가 조니 밀러네 집 주위에서 울부짖었고, 바로 그날 저녁 쏙독새가 집 안으로 들어와 난간에 앉아 울었다는데, 거기 아직 아무도 안 죽었어.

chunks.en: “Say, Tom—they say
a stray dog come howling around Johnny Miller’s house,
chunks.ko: 떠돌이 개가 조니 밀러네 집 주위에서 울부짖었대,

chunks.en: ’bout midnight, as much as two weeks ago;
and a whippoorwill come in and lit on the banisters and sung,
chunks.ko: 그리고 쏙독새가 들어와 난간에 앉아 울었대,

chunks.en: the very same evening;
and there ain’t anybody dead there yet.”
chunks.ko: 그런데 거기 아직 아무도 안 죽었어.

en: There was no voice of rebuke; but there were averted eyes; there was a silence and an air of solemnity that struck a chill to the culprit’s heart.
ko: 꾸짖는 목소리는 없었다. 하지만 외면하는 눈길이 있었고, 죄인(톰)의 가슴을 오싹하게 하는 침묵과 엄숙한 분위기가 있었다.

chunks.en: There was no voice of rebuke;
but there were averted eyes;
there was a silence and an air of solemnity
that struck a chill to the culprit’s heart.

en: He sat down and tried to seem gay, but it was up-hill work; it roused no smile, no response, and he lapsed into silence and let his heart sink down to the depths.
ko: 그는 자리에 앉아 명랑한 척해 보려 했지만 힘겨운 일이었다. 아무 웃음도 반응도 얻지 못하자 그는 입을 다물고 마음이 밑바닥까지 가라앉도록 내버려 두었다.

chunks.en: He sat down and tried to seem gay,
but it was up-hill work;
it roused no smile, no response,
and he lapsed into silence
and let his heart sink down to the depths.

en: After breakfast his aunt took him aside, and Tom almost brightened in the hope that he was going to be flogged; but it was not so.
ko: 아침 식사 후 이모가 톰을 따로 불렀고, 톰은 매를 맞겠구나 하는 기대에 얼굴이 거의 밝아질 뻔했다. 하지만 그렇지 않았다.

chunks.en: After breakfast his aunt took him aside,
chunks.ko: 아침 식사 후 이모가 그를 따로 불렀고,

chunks.en: and Tom almost brightened
in the hope that he was going to be flogged;
but it was not so.

en: His aunt wept over him and asked him how he could go and break her old heart so; and finally told him to go on, and ruin himself and bring her gray hairs with sorrow to the grave, for it was no use for her to try any more.
ko: 이모는 톰을 두고 울면서 어떻게 그렇게 늙은 이모 가슴을 찢어 놓을 수 있느냐고 물었다. 그러고는 마침내, 이제 자기가 더 애써 봐야 소용없으니 계속 그렇게 해서 스스로를 망치고 자기 흰머리를 슬픔 속에 무덤으로 보내라고 말했다.

chunks.en: His aunt wept over him
and asked him how he could go
and break her old heart so;
chunks.ko: 늙은 자기 가슴을 그렇게 찢어 놓을 수 있느냐고;

chunks.en: and finally told him to go on,
and ruin himself
and bring her gray hairs with sorrow to the grave,
chunks.ko: 자기 흰머리를 슬픔 속에 무덤으로 보내라고,

chunks.en: for it was no use for her to try any more.

en: He cried, he pleaded for forgiveness, promised to reform over and over again, and then received his dismissal, feeling that he had won but an imperfect forgiveness and established but a feeble confidence.
ko: 그는 울고, 용서를 빌고, 고치겠다고 몇 번이고 약속한 뒤 물러가라는 말을 들었다. 불완전한 용서와 미약한 신뢰밖에 얻지 못했다고 느끼면서.

chunks.en: He cried, he pleaded for forgiveness,
promised to reform over and over again,
and then received his dismissal,
feeling that he had won but an imperfect forgiveness
and established but a feeble confidence.

en: He left the presence too miserable to even feel revengeful toward Sid; and so the latter’s prompt retreat through the back gate was unnecessary.
ko: 그는 너무 비참해서 시드에게 복수심조차 느끼지 못한 채 이모 앞에서 물러났다. 그래서 시드가 뒷문으로 재빨리 달아난 것은 쓸데없는 일이었다.

chunks.en: He left the presence
too miserable to even feel revengeful toward Sid;
chunks.ko: 너무 비참해서 시드에게 복수심조차 느낄 수 없는 채로;

chunks.en: and so the latter’s prompt retreat through the back gate
chunks.ko: 그래서 후자(시드)가 뒷문으로 재빨리 달아난 것은

chunks.en: was unnecessary.

en: He moped to school gloomy and sad, and took his flogging, along with Joe Harper, for playing hookey the day before, with the air of one whose heart was busy with heavier woes and wholly dead to trifles.
ko: 그는 우울하고 슬픈 얼굴로 터덜터덜 학교에 가서, 전날 땡땡이친 벌로 조 하퍼와 함께 매를 맞았다. 마음이 더 무거운 슬픔으로 가득 차 사소한 일에는 완전히 무감각해진 사람 같은 태도로.

chunks.en: He moped to school gloomy and sad,
chunks.ko: 그는 우울하고 슬프게 터덜터덜 학교로 갔고,

chunks.en: and took his flogging, along with Joe Harper,
for playing hookey the day before,
with the air of one
whose heart was busy with heavier woes
chunks.ko: 마음이 더 무거운 슬픔으로 가득 차서

chunks.en: and wholly dead to trifles.

en: Then he betook himself to his seat, rested his elbows on his desk and his jaws in his hands, and stared at the wall with the stony stare of suffering that has reached the limit and can no further go.
ko: 그러고 나서 그는 자기 자리로 가서 팔꿈치를 책상에 올리고 두 손에 턱을 괸 채, 한계에 다다라 더는 갈 데 없는 고통의 돌처럼 굳은 시선으로 벽을 노려보았다.

chunks.en: Then he betook himself to his seat,
chunks.ko: 그러고 나서 그는 자기 자리로 갔고,

chunks.en: rested his elbows on his desk
and his jaws in his hands,
and stared at the wall
with the stony stare of suffering
that has reached the limit and can no further go.
chunks.ko: 한계에 이르러 더는 갈 데 없는 (고통).
